title: AsTeams
description: Advanced Team Management Plugin for Survival & Network Servers with Roles, Vaults, Diplomacy, and Cross-Server Support.
body:
# 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 AsTeams
### Advanced Team Management Plugin for Survival & Network Servers

AsTeams is a powerful and fully network-ready Team System plugin designed for SMP, Lifesteal, Earth and Survival servers.  
It provides an advanced team experience with internal role management, shared vaults, diplomacy system and cross-server support.

---

## 👨‍💻 Developer
**ItzAzeem**

## 💬 Support Server
Join our Discord for support, updates & suggestions:  
https://discord.gg/xRW5rdAvs5

---

## 🔥 Features

- Team Creation System
- Advanced Role Management
- Team Vault (Shared Storage)
- Diplomacy System (Ally / Enemy)
- Friendly Fire Toggle
- Team Homes
- Team Logs
- Team Level System
- Cross Server Support
- MySQL Storage
- Async Saving
- Bungee / Velocity Support

---

## 📜 Commands

| Command | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| /team create <name> | Create a team |
| /team invite <player> | Invite player |
| /team join <team> | Join team |
| /team leave | Leave team |
| /team kick <player> | Kick member |
| /team promote <player> | Promote member |
| /team demote <player> | Demote member |
| /team info | Team information |
| /team chat <msg> | Team chat |
| /team home | Teleport to team home |
| /team sethome | Set team home |
| /team vault | Open team vault |
| /team ally <team> | Ally request |
| /team enemy <team> | Declare enemy |
| /team pvp toggle | Toggle Friendly Fire |
| /team transfer <player> | Transfer ownership |
| /team rename <name> | Rename team |
| /team description <text> | Team description |
| /team top | Top teams list |
| /team disband | Delete team (Owner Only) |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

Admin Permission Allows:

- Force Join Team
- Force Kick Player
- Disband Any Team
- Rename Team
- Bypass Limits

---

## 🌐 Network Ready

- MySQL Based Data Storage  
- Cross Server Team Sync  
- Async Saving  
- BungeeCord Support  
- Velocity Support  
- Developer API Ready  

---

Made with ❤️ by **ItzAzeem**
